_readme: Policy and grant for the Hamburg building-level flood-risk EXAMPLE layer -- the demo
object for the ORE Method Article. Mirrors the production Hamburg policy field-for-field.
The dataset and policy URIs are NOT free choices: the ODRL Access Policy template
so Nanodash only accepts the suffix. They are identifiers, not locators.
The domain is currently unregistered (NXDOMAIN); rohub_ro is where the object resolves.
Publish in this order: policy first, then grant (the grant needs the policy's nanopub URI).

policy.template_label: ODRL Access Policy for FAIR Data

target.label: Hamburg building-level pluvial flood-risk example layer

grant.template_label: ODRL Access Grant for FAIR Data
grant._template_note: RAoLSO is the template the Science Live platform offers (hardcoded as ODRL_ACCESS_GRANT in its template registry). It differs from the earlier RAeRMv only by carrying rdfs:label for the three action URIs (so they render as names, not URIs) and by dropping the FAIR2Adapt tags and the datasetUri/policyNanopubUri prefix constraints. Because it has no prefix, the dataset URI must be pasted in full and MUST match the policy's target exactly -- a mismatch does not error, it silently produces a grant verify_access can never match.
